purpose: Screen honest one-B70 Qwen3.8 Q4_K_M target plus same-revision Q4_0 MTP draft depths before any strict promotion.

fixed_profile.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70, physical GPU 0
fixed_profile.transport: native raw /completion with returned token IDs

screen.headline_formula: median within each class, then median of six class medians

decision_rule.screen_only: No one-server screen value is a public package headline.
decision_rule.winner: Highest class-balanced rate among arms that pass every workload, cache, natural-stop/length, canary, and complete-token-array target-oracle gate.
decision_rule.promotion: Run the winner on a second fresh server. Promote only the median of the two attempt-level class-balanced medians when all 12 complete arrays match across the two MTP servers and the target-only oracle, or disclose and adjudicate any arithmetic-identity difference before promotion.
decision_rule.no_transfer: No result transfers to Q8, TP2, vLLM, alternate context depths, concurrency, chat-template serving, or another draft artifact.
